systems.country_label: Registre national de la population (RNP); identifiant digital civil et social (IDCS)
systems.tiers: over 18.4 million people enrolled at 31 December 2023; enrolment agents use a back-office system; second World Bank project (PICPPS II, four years from 30 November 2024) to extend coverage, notably in isolated rural areas
